posts.text: Negative Returns Since the Initial Public Offering This is possibly the most unstructured story on a business or stock. It therefore starts with Sintercom India getting listed on the NSE SME exchange in February 2018. The issue price was INR65. More than eight years down the line, Sintercom India stock trades at INR75. Considering 8 years, stock returns have been at a CAGR of 1.8%. More importantly, it’s negative, when adjusted for inflation. That’s disappointing, to say the least, for a high-risk SME stock. Why I Am Still Writing About Sintercom?
